name: Floppy
source:
"Oh, are you sleeping there again? I can’t imagine you’ll sleep well like that..."

Loved by all as the selfless housemother of Lost Eden, she is a goddess of domestic chores thanks to deft gadget manipulation.
Though a cute pet robot now, she was once an electric SHEEP.

She may be a first-rate mom, but as a SHEEP, she’s scrap metal.
Says things like, "My oh my!" in soft-spoken, ladylike tones.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2051100]Steam[/url]]
